variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished full-screen iPhone portrait background painting for the Starfall puzzle game's fourth playable zone, Seed Moon, 100% restored. Create ONE image, exact portrait 1:2 ratio, ideally 887x1774 pixels. Premium polished storybook 3D diorama with rounded moonstone, translucent botanical jade, luminous roots and fine tactile details, cohesive with a gentle celestial toy-like universe. Camera floats high above looking down obliquely, zoomed far back: this is a playable board environment with the destination in the upper background, not a close-up scene.
Scene: a small round pale pearl moon shell, already split into two broad softly worn halves, cradles one magical seed. A single curling translucent mint stem rises from it and opens at the top into a broad five-leaf shelter canopy, pale jade outer leaves and one soft ivory-gold luminous center. The shell remains the recognizable round base. Connected warm-mint root veins follow old seams in the shell and down its little stone ledge; a tiny empty resting ledge and one gardening scoop suggest care, but NO people or creatures. Make this green living shelter clearly different from docks/boats/lanterns.
Composition is critical: place this entire moon garden in the UPPER LEFT third, spanning approximately x 4–58%, y 2–28%. The open canopy and brightest little center must be near x 24%, y 7%, fully inside the image, away from the top-center score HUD. Keep the top-center/right mostly dark blue-teal sky. Preserve a large continuous dark indigo/teal/lilac sky playfield from y32% through86%, with quiet natural nebula texture, sparse pinprick distant stars, and low violet clouds around the outer edges only. Lower edge: a few peripheral crescent moonstone pebbles with subtle mint root veins at the two bottom corners, dark underneath future white controls. No bright white clouds across the lower central control area. This is a single natural continuous painting: NO rectangular board, NO center clearing/mask/vignette patch, NO horizontal cloud seam. The sky texture must continue through the center. Moon shell should feel floating in sky, not occupying the board.
Full restoration: canopy spread and central bud open, luminous sheltered nook under its leaves, all roots gently connected and glowing. Emotional tone warm, safe, hopeful; cool region palette remains blue/mint/opal with restrained warm core. No text, numbers, letters, logos, watermarks, UI, tiles, jewels, characters, faces, eyes, hands, walking figures, bridges, boats, lanterns or villain. Keep radiance softer than bright playable crystal stars that will be added by the actual game.
variants.inspection: Strong moon/canopy silhouette and continuous sky; upright gold center remains closed, so retained as 75% instead of100.
